item.text: {"paper_id":"paper009","profile_id":"neuroscience","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"We investigated population-wide changes in prescriptions of oral anticoagulants (OAC) (vitamin K antagonists [VKA]) compared to direct oral anticoagulants (DOAC) and whether these translated into a decline in incidences of OAC-related intracerebral hemorrhages (ICH).","rationale":"The study directly examines intracerebral hemorrhage incidence and its association with anticoagulant use, aligning with the profile’s interests in stroke, neural injury, and treatment safety for neurological outcomes.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
